name: random_trader
summary: This EA opens random buy or sell positions with no analytical strategy, using either ATR-based or fixed pip stop loss and take profit. It includes a breakeven mechanism and risk-based position sizing with margin validation. The core trading decision is purely random, making it a gambling-style scalping EA.
summary_zh: 该EA随机开仓买入或卖出，无任何分析策略，使用基于ATR或固定点数的止损止盈。包含保本机制和基于风险的仓位管理及保证金验证。核心交易决策完全随机，属于赌博式剥头皮EA。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于纯随机入场，使用MathRand()生成0或1来决定买入或卖出，没有任何技术分析或市场判断。入场条件完全随机，在无持仓时即刻开仓，不等待任何信号。出场条件依赖固定比例的止损止盈（reward_risk_ratio默认2:1）和保本机制——当价格朝有利方向移动指定点数后，止损移至开仓价。仓位管理使用基于风险的仓位计算，根据账户余额、风险百分比和止损距离计算手数，并包含保证金检查和最大可用保证金适配。资金管理方面，默认每笔交易风险1%账户余额，支持最大保证金使用选项，但缺乏最大回撤控制或每日亏损限制。该EA本质上是一个随机赌博系统，没有任何可重复的统计优势。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on purely random entry, using MathRand() to generate 0 or 1 to decide buy or sell, with no technical analysis or market judgment whatsoever. Entry conditions are completely random — a new position is opened immediately whenever no position exists, without waiting for any signal. Exit conditions rely on fixed-ratio stop loss and take profit (default reward_risk_ratio of 2:1) and a breakeven mechanism that moves the stop loss to the entry price after the price moves a specified number of pips in the favorable direction. Position sizing uses risk-based lot calculation, computing size from account balance, risk percentage, and stop loss distance, with margin checking and maximum available margin adaptation. Money management defaults to 1% risk per trade of account balance, with an option to use maximum available margin, but lacks max drawdown control or daily loss limits. The EA is essentially a random gambling system with no repeatable statistical edge.

pros: 具备完善的止损止盈验证机制，考虑了StopLevel和FreezeLevel限制
仓位管理基于风险百分比计算，包含保证金检查和自动适配最大可用保证金
保本机制可以在价格有利时保护资本，将止损移至开仓价
代码结构清晰，使用面向对象的CTradeValidation类封装交易验证逻辑
支持ATR动态止损和固定点数止损两种模式，提供灵活性
pros_en: Comprehensive SL/TP validation mechanism considering StopLevel and FreezeLevel constraints
Risk-percentage-based position sizing with margin checking and automatic max-margin adaptation
Breakeven mechanism protects capital by moving stop loss to entry price when in profit
Clean code structure using object-oriented CTradeValidation class for trade validation logic
Supports both ATR-based dynamic and fixed-pip stop loss modes for flexibility
cons: 核心交易决策完全随机，没有任何统计优势，长期必然亏损
缺少新K线检查，每个tick都可能尝试开仓，可能导致频繁无效调用
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下止损可能过近导致被轻易触发
保证金不足时自动使用最大可用保证金(use_max_margin=true)可能导致过度杠杆
只允许同时持有一个仓位，严重限制了策略的多样性和灵活性
tick代码拼写错误（tiket应为ticket），反映代码审查不足
cons_en: Core trading decision is purely random with no statistical edge, guaranteed long-term loss
No new bar check — attempts to open position on every tick, causing frequent ineffective calls
No spread filter — high spread environments can easily trigger stop losses placed too close
Auto max-margin usage (use_max_margin=true by default) can lead to excessive leverage when margin is insufficient
Only one position allowed at a time, severely limiting strategy diversification and flexibility
Variable name typo (tiket instead of ticket) reflects insufficient code review
improvements: 用实际的技术分析信号替代随机入场，如趋势指标或动量指标，以建立统计优势
添加新K线检查和点差过滤，避免在高点差环境下交易和重复无效的开仓尝试
添加最大回撤限制和每日亏损限制，防止连续随机亏损导致账户爆仓
默认关闭use_max_margin选项，避免自动使用最大保证金导致过度杠杆
修复变量命名错误（tiket→ticket）并添加错误处理和日志记录
improvements_en: Replace random entry with actual technical analysis signals (trend/momentum indicators) to establish a statistical edge
Add new bar check and spread filter to avoid trading in high-spread environments and repeated ineffective open attempts
Add max drawdown limit and daily loss limit to prevent account blowup from consecutive random losses
Default use_max_margin to false to prevent automatic max-margin usage leading to excessive leverage
Fix variable naming typo (tiket→ticket) and add error handling and logging

risk_points: 交易决策完全随机，无任何市场分析，长期必然亏损
默认启用最大保证金使用，可能在低保证金时过度杠杆
无最大回撤或每日亏损限制，连续亏损可能迅速消耗账户
无点差过滤，高点差环境下止损极易被触发
risk_points_en: Trading decisions are completely random with no market analysis, guaranteed long-term loss
Max margin usage enabled by default, can lead to excessive leverage when margin is low
No max drawdown or daily loss limits, consecutive losses can rapidly deplete account
No spread filter, stop losses easily triggered in high-spread environments
